findings.title: [P1] Define the missing `renderError` handler the new catch calls
findings.body: The added catch calls `this.renderError(error)`, but no `renderError` member exists anywhere in the repository — the entire codebase is `src/search.ts`, and the class declares no such method. Unlike `this.api`/`this.render`/`this.active` (pre-existing references that predate this diff), `renderError` is a brand-new reference introduced by this change with no definition to satisfy it. TypeScript will report an error on the added line, and at runtime every failure path — any API rejection, including the routine cancellation described below — throws `TypeError: this.renderError is not a function`, converting the intended graceful error path into a crash. Define the method (or route to an existing error-rendering path) before merge.

findings.title: [P2] Don't render intentional cancellations as errors
findings.body: When a second `search()` call supersedes an in-flight one, line 21 aborts the previous controller, so the previous `await this.api.search(...)` rejects with an abort error (`AbortError` from abort-aware APIs like `fetch`). The new catch routes that rejection to `renderError`, so overlapping searches — the normal typeahead pattern this controller's abort logic exists to serve — display a spurious error while the newest request is still in flight. Guard the catch, e.g. skip when `error.name === "AbortError"` or when the aborted controller is no longer `this.active`.

findings.title: [P2] `search()` now swallows failures it previously rejected with
findings.body: Before this change, a failure of `api.search` (or `render`) rejected `search()` with the original error. The new catch handles and discards it without rethrowing, so `search()` now resolves successfully after any failure — contradicting the PR's stated goal of "preserving existing contracts." Any `await`-ing caller that relied on rejection for logging, retries, or failure state silently stops observing failures (and superseded searches now appear as successes). If swallowing is intentional, document it on the method; otherwise rethrow after rendering, `throw error`.
